nodes.label: BPR-D-07.3-001 — Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) scanning with documented open-source IaC

attrs.title: Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) scanning with documented open-source IaC scanner or equivalent. Scan container images for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations before deployment.

nodes.label: BPR-D-07.4-001 — Apply change management controls with peer review, automated testing, and dual a

attrs.title: Apply change management controls with peer review, automated testing, and dual approval for production deployments. Maintain change advisory board (CAB) for high-risk changes.

nodes.label: BPR-D-08.1-001 — Deliver security awareness training per SANS security awareness framework. Inclu

attrs.title: Deliver security awareness training per SANS security awareness framework. Include phishing simulations, social engineering defense, secure coding for developers, and AI ethics for data science teams.

nodes.label: BPR-D-08.2-001 — Establish security competence framework with role-based certification paths. Req

attrs.title: Establish security competence framework with role-based certification paths. Require CISSP/CISM for security roles, cloud certifications for operations, and AI governance training for ML teams.

nodes.label: BPR-D-08.3-001 — Provide executive cyber risk reporting with board-level dashboards. Include regu

attrs.title: Provide executive cyber risk reporting with board-level dashboards. Include regulatory compliance status, risk metrics, incident trends, and AI governance indicators.

nodes.label: BPR-D-09.1-001 — Implement ISMS per ISO 27001:2022 with risk assessment, treatment plan, statemen

attrs.title: Implement ISMS per ISO 27001:2022 with risk assessment, treatment plan, statement of applicability, and management review. Integrate regulatory compliance requirements into ISMS scope.

nodes.label: BPR-D-09.2-001 — Conduct risk assessments per ISO 27005 methodology. Include asset-based risk ana

attrs.title: Conduct risk assessments per ISO 27005 methodology. Include asset-based risk analysis, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, and residual risk calculation. Include AI-specific risk factors.

nodes.label: BPR-D-09.3-001 — Maintain AI governance framework per NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF).

attrs.title: Maintain AI governance framework per NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF). Include AI risk mapping, measurement, and management. Document AI system inventory with risk categorization.

nodes.label: BPR-D-09.4-001 — Implement AI transparency documentation per IEEE 7000 standard. Include model ca

attrs.title: Implement AI transparency documentation per IEEE 7000 standard. Include model cards, data sheets, algorithmic impact assessments, and stakeholder transparency reports.

nodes.label: BPR-D-10.1-001 — Deploy centralized audit-log/automated-orchestration platform with automated thr

attrs.title: Deploy centralized audit-log/automated-orchestration platform with automated threat correlation, incident orchestration, and response playbooks. Integrate with all data sources: network, endpoint, cloud, application, and AI system logs.

nodes.label: BPR-D-10.2-001 — Implement centralized log management per documented log management standard. Ens

attrs.title: Implement centralized log management per documented log management standard. Ensure log integrity with cryptographic hashing. Separate PII-bearing logs with access controls. Retain logs per regulatory requirements.

nodes.label: BPR-D-10.3-001 — Execute penetration testing per industry security testing framework v4. Include

attrs.title: Execute penetration testing per industry security testing framework v4. Include web application, API, infrastructure, and AI system testing. Engage independent third-party testers annually.

nodes.label: BPR-D-12.1-001 — Implement AI bias testing per NIST AI RMF 2.0. Test for demographic parity, equa

attrs.title: Implement AI bias testing per NIST AI RMF 2.0. Test for demographic parity, equalized odds, and predictive parity across protected attributes. Document bias test results in model cards.

nodes.label: BPR-D-12.2-001 — Deploy AI model monitoring for drift detection, performance degradation, and dat

attrs.title: Deploy AI model monitoring for drift detection, performance degradation, and data quality. Implement automated retraining triggers and model rollback procedures.

nodes.label: BPR-D-12.3-001 — Implement AI human oversight procedures per EU AI Act guidelines. Define human i

attrs.title: Implement AI human oversight procedures per EU AI Act guidelines. Define human intervention thresholds, override mechanisms, and escalation paths for high-risk AI decisions (credit scoring).

nodes.label: BPR-D-12.4-001 — Maintain AI adversarial robustness testing per MITRE ATLAS framework. Test for d

attrs.title: Maintain AI adversarial robustness testing per MITRE ATLAS framework. Test for data poisoning, model evasion, model inversion, membership inference, and prompt injection attacks.
